events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: It's been 35 years since we said goodbye to Freddie Mercury, but his voice and showmanship remain utterly unmatched. He would have been 80 today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, featuring classics like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life'.

angles.name: Timeless Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative as it did 61 years ago.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace, however, live on. He would have been 86.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary 'Starman' David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating Bowie
angles.copy: A true icon, David Bowie would have been 80 today. From Ziggy Stardust to the Thin White Duke, his influence is still felt everywhere.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, King
angles.copy: The one and only King, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the world with his timeless hits.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! What's your favourite riff from the Led Zeppelin maestro?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Big Day
angles.copy: He's still got that distinctive voice! Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the legend that is Sir Rod Stewart.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing the house down and making us skank.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's Day
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got those smooth vocals that made us swoon in the 80s.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend, businesswoman, and icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Dolly
angles.copy: She's 81 today and still working 9 to 5! Happy birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton, a true force of nature.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and pop superstar Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, he's given us so many unforgettable tunes.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for hits like 'Caribbean Queen', celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Get Outta My Dreams
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean! Still making us want to dance.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame's First Induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall Of Fame History
angles.copy: Remembering the very first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony from 1989. Who was your favourite among the inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark
angles.copy: Wishing Mark Owen a very happy 55th birthday! Still got those boyband moves and tunes.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye to live performances!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo superstar Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal legend.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Big Day
angles.copy: He's bringing sexy back at 46! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Pop Larkin, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! What's your favourite character he's played?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Music Legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, we lost three giants: Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. The music may have died, but their legacy lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon and internet sensation Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: He's never gonna give up on turning another year older! Happy 61st birthday to the legendary Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: The king of reggae, Bob Marley, would have been 82 today. His message of peace, love, and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter and music icon Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: From writing countless classics to her own iconic albums, Carole King is a songwriting legend. Happy 85th birthday!

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the passing of the incomparable Whitney Houston, who would have been 64.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: 15 years ago, we lost the voice of a generation, Whitney Houston. She would have been 64, and her incredible talent is still deeply missed.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, millions of hearts broke as Take That announced their split after years of pop dominance.

angles.name: A Day of Pop History
angles.copy: Remember when Take That split? 29 years ago today, the pop world was in mourning. Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine & Birthdays
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the unmistakable voice of UB40! What's your favourite track from the reggae legends?

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Ed!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! Still crafting those chart-topping tunes.
